pearls.pearl: Use MUDPILES to recall causes of anion gap metabolic acidosis: Methanol, Uremia, DKA, Propylene glycol, Iron/INH, Lactic acidosis, Ethylene glycol, Salicylates.
Light's Criteria: a pleural effusion is exudative if any one of pleural/serum protein >0.5, pleural/serum LDH >0.6, or pleural LDH >2/3 the upper limit of normal serum LDH.
CHA2DS2-VASc score ≥2 in men / ≥3 in women generally warrants anticoagulation in non-valvular atrial fibrillation for stroke risk reduction.
Ranson's Criteria predicts severity of acute pancreatitis at admission and 48 hours; higher scores correlate with increased mortality.
In DKA, give IV fluids and insulin but hold insulin until potassium is ≥3.3 mEq/L to avoid life-threatening hypokalemia.
The CURB-65 score (Confusion, Urea, Respiratory rate, Blood pressure, age ≥65) guides admission decisions in community-acquired pneumonia.
Smudge cells on peripheral smear are characteristic of chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL).
Troponin rises 3–4 hours after myocardial injury, peaks at 24 hours, and remains elevated up to 1–2 weeks.
